card_text: Kids' haircuts from Hobbs: booking the siblings back to back and aiming for a Saturday morning.

seo.title: Kids' Haircuts for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Kids' haircuts for Hobbs families, cut in Carlsbad west on US 62/180. Booking brothers and sisters back to back, and why Saturday morning works.

paragraphs: Kids sit in my chair the same as adults do, and my chair is in Carlsbad: {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles west of Hobbs on {{city:hobbs.route}}, about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes (OpenStreetMap routing) with a car full of kids who are behaving.
Here's how parents from Lea County can book more than one child at once, and why a Saturday morning is the time to aim for.

blocks.heading: Book the siblings together.
paragraphs: Hobbs is young. Census ACS 2023 puts {{city:hobbs.under18_pct}} of the city under 18, against {{city:carlsbad.under18_pct}} in Carlsbad, and counts about {{city:hobbs.k12_students}} kids enrolled in K–12 there. That's a lot of households with more than one head to cut.
Booksy has no kids' service, so each child gets a regular haircut booking. Book them back to back, and add your own cut to the run if you want one. One drive, every head done.

blocks.heading: What to book for a kid.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: A fade, a taper or a textured top, scaled to a smaller head, with the neck cleaned up. Book one per child.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: For the parent in the lineup: haircut with a beard trim or line-up and a hot towel.

blocks.heading: Saturday from Hobbs.
paragraphs: Saturday I'm open 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Leave Hobbs early enough for the first slots and you're home for lunch, with nobody tired yet.
If a kid has a photo of the cut they want, bring it. For lines cut in, the hair design add-on is {{addon:hair-design}}.

items.q: Can I book two or three kids in a row?
items.a: Yes. Book each one a separate haircut on Booksy, one after the other, and text me at {{phone}} if the slots don't line up.
No. Kids book the regular haircut services at the Booksy price, {{price:essential-haircut}} for the Essential Haircut.

items.q: What if my kid is nervous about the clippers?
items.a: I work alone, so they'll see the same barber every trip. That familiarity helps more than anything.

items.q: Where can I see kids' cuts you've done?
items.a: The kids' haircuts page has photos from my chair.
